abstract: BACKGROUND: In a retrospective study that included a detailed histopathologic review, the clinicopathologic features of patients with germ cell tumors (GCT) and resectable residual masses after chemotherapy were assessed. METHODS: Histologic material from 153 patients was available for review. Recorded details included primary histologic diagnosis, location, size and number of metastases, marker levels before and after chemotherapy, and completeness of surgical excision. A median of seven histologic sections per resection were reviewed by two pathologists independently (and together when disagreement occurred). In each case, details were recorded regarding fibrosis, necrosis, hemorrhage, embryonal carcinoma (undifferentiated teratoma), yolk sac tumor, choriocarcinoma (trophoblastic tumor), differentiated teratoma (mature and immature), dysplasia in somatic tissues, and non- germ cell tumor (GCT) malignancies. The percentage of the sample that each of these components comprised was also estimated. RESULTS: The median postchemotherapy follow-up time was 7 years, and 38 of 153 patients (25%) experienced disease progression. In a multivariate analysis, incomplete resection of all residual masses (in 38 patients) and the presence of malignant elements (in 23 patients) were independent risk factors for progression. In the subset of patients in whom all masses were completely resected, the presence of embryonal carcinoma (undifferentiated teratoma) was the single most significant risk factor for progression. Seven percent of patients had this factor, which was associated with a 2-year progression free survival rate of 12.5%, compared with 88.0% where this component was absent. CONCLUSIONS: Progression free survival can be predicted well by the completeness of excision of residual masses and the presence of malignant germ cell elements. The latter confers a relatively poor prognosis even if all of these elements are completely resected.
abstract_ja: 背景：化学療法後に切除可能な残存腫瘤を有する胚細胞腫瘍患者の臨床病理学的特徴について、後方視的研究で評価した。方法：153例の組織標本を利用可能であった。記録された詳細には、一次組織学的診断、部位、転移の大きさと個数、化学療法前後のマーカー値、および外科的切除の完全性が含まれた。各切除標本について、線維化、壊死、出血、胎児性癌（未分化奇形腫）、卵黄嚢腫瘍、絨毛癌（栄養膜腫瘍）、分化奇形腫（成熟型および未熟型）、体細胞組織の異形成、胚細胞腫瘍以外の悪性腫瘍について詳細を記録した。各切除標本の中央値7切片を2名の病理医が独立して（不一致の場合は共同で）検討した。各成分が標本に占める割合も推定した。結果：追跡期間中央値は7年であり、38例（25%）が病勢進行を経験した。多変量解析では、全残存腫瘤の不完全切除（38例）と悪性成分の存在（23例）が進行の独立した危険因子であった。全腫瘤が完全に切除された患者のサブセットでは、胎児性癌（未分化奇形腫）の存在が進行の単独で最も有意な危険因子であった。この因子を有する患者は7%であり、この因子がある場合の2年無増悪生存率は12.5%で、ない場合は88.0%であった。結論：無増悪生存期間は残存腫瘤の切除の完全性と悪性胚細胞成分の存在により良好に予測できる。後者は、すべての成分が完全に切除されたとしても、比較的不良な予後と関連する。
